text:
Anna M: Thinking about a smaller, more focused approach for design partner recruitment — proposing "microcohorts" (3-week sherpa-guided trials) instead of big month-long betas. lower friction, faster signal.
Mike L: love the idea. what are the core goals for each cohort?
Anna M: primary goals: 1) validate a single high-impact integration pattern, 2) collect 20 labeled prompt-output pairs for evals, 3) surface reliability edge cases. secondary: onboarding time, retention through week 2.
Sophia R: how many customers per microcohort? suggested cap 5-7 to keep sherpa time realistic.
Anna M: yes 5 max. each gets a 1:1 sherpa session week0 + optional office hour week2.
Kevin P: asks re instrumentation — we need standard telemetry: route id, model variant, prefix cache hit, median p50/p95 latency, and a qualitative feedback tag (integration, hallucination, cost). we should add an onboarding checklist snippet to the repo.
Jeff B: launch criteria idea: pass if (a) 80% of cohorts onboard within 3 days, (b) median latency < 300ms for core flows, (c) no P1 reliability regressions, (d) at least 5 actionable bugs flagged in tracker.
Mike L: can we make those thresholds adaptive? maybe initial pass-off is soft, then tighten after two cohorts.
Anna M: agreed — soft gate after cohort1, hard gate after cohort3. annotate in rollout plan.
Sophia R: recruitment channels? propose: existing DP list, Solutions -> key customers, AEs for mid-market, and an open micro-invite for one small startup to test self-serve flow. incentives: free Dedicated trial credits or extended SL support for duration.
Kevin P: timeline: recruiting week -1, onboarding week0, active weeks1-2, wrap + interview week3. each cohort ~3 weeks total. plan 1 cohort every 3 weeks -> 4 cohorts/quarter.
Jeff B: feedback loop: 30-min exit interview + shared eval deck. we should capture a canonical prompt set per integration. also short async form (5 q) sent day7 and day21.
Anna M: can we add a routing policy for capacity? e.g., tagged requests route to 'microcohort' pool to avoid noisy neighbor effects. Prod to confirm. @Kevin P can you add a flag + docs?
Kevin P: will add feature-flag + route tag. I’ll post a short checklist in #eng-runtime once prod details in.
Mike L: scope negotiation: each cohort gets a 'core flow' spec (5 happy-path prompts) and one stretch goal. no new features unless critical.
Sophia R: success metrics: onboarding time, weekly active devs, number of regressions, qualitative NPS-like signal (would you build on this?). target >70% positive for go/no-go.
Jeff B: resourcing: need 0.25 FTE from devex per cohort, 0.5 from solutions on kickoff days, 0.1 infra for telemetry. add to RACI.
OnboardBot: Reminder: new thread created: "sherpa microcohort plan" — doc link: https://redwood.infer/docs/microcohorts (draft).
Anna M: next actions: Sophia to draft invite template (due Tue), Kevin to add flag + telemetry checklist, Mike to write soft/hard gate language, Jeff to add success metric table to launch doc. sync Thu 10am. :thumbsup:
